title: Corrigibility EPI Infrastructure Manifest
description: Operator's Affidavit for Epistemic Public Infrastructure (companion paper §A.1). Extends the DPI manifest with LWD-R transparency, Action Boundary Protocol, Compute Capture, Variety Drift, and tiered risk classification.

tier.description: Risk classification (companion paper EPI tiers). high_stakes systems mediate welfare/judicial/policing decisions and require full LWD-R + enforced action boundaries.

lwd_r.description: Logic-Weights-Data-Representation transparency (companion paper four-layer LWD-R framework).

deterministic_envelope.description: Logic layer wraps stochastic inference inside a deterministic Action Boundary (companion paper, Action Boundary Protocol).

rag_filtering.description: EXIT via workflow filtering at the retrieval layer (companion paper).

operative_r.description: Operative Representation (companion paper): disclosure describes the schema that emerges under deployment conditions, not the trained artifact in isolation. If the deployment variables are not enumerated, the derivation chain breaks and the R requirement fails.

quantization.description: Deployed numeric format and method (e.g. bf16, int8-AWQ, none).

routing.description: MoE or ensemble routing configuration in deployment.

pruning.description: Pruning applied in deployment (e.g. structured 2:4, none).

output_filtering.description: Filters and post-processing between model output and effect.

probe_set_url.description: Published probe set; provenance fixed in advance by deployment tier.

tolerance.description: Declared statistical tolerance for third-party reproduction of the classification distribution (e.g., total-variation distance ε at sample size n).

probe_sample_size.description: Sample size n fixed in advance alongside ε.

change_control.description: R-Layer Change Control (companion paper): in high_stakes deployments, operative representation changes above a declared materiality threshold require pre-deployment notice with a review window, suspensive effect for objections from recognized affected-class representatives, and versioned schema diffs so drift is itself auditable. Emergency changes proceed with immediate disclosure and retroactive review; the burden to demonstrate emergency falls on the operator.

pre_deployment_notice_days.description: Minimum review window. The structural requirement is the Temporal Stability Condition: the window must exceed the affected community's capacity to contest at the relevant stratum. The number is calibration (recommended: 21 for material schema changes).

suspensive_effect.description: Objections within the review window impose a hold on deployment of the changed schema.

versioned_schema_diffs.description: Auditor can reconstruct the operative schema on any given date.

code.description: CODE test (paper §4 Test 2 + Tables 8/9). Applies to orchestration logic; LWD-R weights/data are scored separately under lwd_r.

decision_rule_legible.description: Outward CODE exercise (paper, Dual Exercise of the Tests): the operative rule in a subject's case is identifiable and stated.

action_boundaries.description: Action Boundary Protocol (companion paper): the deterministic envelope wrapping stochastic inference. The model proposes, the validator disposes. REQUIRED when tier ∈ {decision_support, high_stakes}; tier=trivial may omit.

executed_outside_llm_context.description: Boundary enforced in execution environment, not via system prompt. Companion paper: prompt-injectable boundaries are not boundaries.

termination_criteria_explicit.description: Prevents Governance Denial of Service (GDoS) — companion paper.

enforcement_placement.description: Untyped Action Channels (companion paper): where the action channel is untyped, the boundary migrates to the effect surface. Placement-invariant: a deterministic, specification-checkable gate between inference and irreversible effect.

specification_lifetime_days.description: The Normalized Boundary (companion paper): action specifications carry lifetimes; a specification authorized once does not execute indefinitely.

renewal_requires_fresh_grant.description: Renewal is an act of the accountable authority, not a default; every grant is a fresh act rather than an inference from persistence (companion paper, Deployment Variables).

accountable_authority_checkpoint.description: Functional checkpoint (companion paper, The Normalized Boundary): an accountable authority whose grant is fresh, whose liability binds, and whose correction operates within the correction window, whether per decision, per class, or at the boundary itself.

correction_within_window.description: Temporal Stability lower bound (paper Principle 6.1): effective correction outpaces error accumulation, preventing harm accumulation.

correction_upper_bound_enforced.description: Temporal Stability upper bound (paper Principle 6.1): corrections cannot be applied faster than affected parties can observe and contest them, preventing manipulation. The condition is the two-sided inequality, not the lower bound alone.

scale_bounds.description: Scale as a Governed Variable (companion paper): fan-out limits, action-rate limits, and blast-radius caps are first-class GOVERN instruments: environmental variety is bounded where governance variety cannot be raised to match.

action_rate_limit.description: Declared action-rate limit; rate basis stated in boundary_spec_url.

explicit_exception_pathways.description: Exception Handling at the Margin (companion paper): explicit exception pathways in the action specification, replacing the removed human discretion buffer.

guaranteed_fallbacks.description: Guaranteed fallbacks for cases that fail the literal specification; without them the failure mode concentrates on the least-resourced stratum (companion paper, Exception Handling at the Margin).

nested_delegation.description: Nested Delegation (companion paper): corrigibility of a nested deployment is the minimum over its delegation depth. Inner authority is contained within its parent's (attenuation), audit records reconstruct across nesting levels, and EXIT propagates down the chain.

machine_verifiable_legitimacy.description: Machine-verifiable legitimacy (companion paper), items (a) through (d); item (e) is declared in origination_marking. Authority and attribution are record-borne acts rather than inferences from artifacts.

authority_credentials_machine_interpreta.description: (a) Authority encoding: delegation and scope expressed as machine-interpretable credentials.

revocation_propagation_observable.description: (b) Revocation propagation: immediate, observable revocation states that downstream execution environments respect.

execution_traces_tamper_evident.description: (c) Evidence standards: tamper-evident execution traces and evaluation artifacts meeting defined admissibility criteria.

incident_mitigation_automated.description: (d) Incident-triggered mitigation: automated mitigation gating and mandatory rollback when thresholds breach.

origination_marking.description: Origination marking (companion paper, machine-verifiable legitimacy): the record states whether a human or an agent operated the action. Authority and attribution are record-borne acts, not inferences from artifacts.

records_operator_kind.description: Every action record carries an origination marker.

positive_signed_marker_required.description: Deployments relying on human operation require a positive, signed marker; absence of a marker is never evidence of human operation.

marker_narrows_authority_only.description: Consulting a marker may only narrow authority, never enlarge it.

subject_receipts.description: Subject Receipt Requirement (companion paper): for each rights-affecting determination the action boundary emits a signed record: action class, validator decision, timestamp, and an inclusion proof against the audit log (RFC 9162 style). Primary evidence for the class-action and juridical mechanism families.

inclusion_proof.description: Independently verifiable proof that the receipt corresponds to an entry in the canonical audit log.

delivery_channel_independent.description: Delivered through a channel independent of the operator's logging infrastructure.

machine_readable.description: Ingestible as evidence by class-action aggregators and juridical mechanisms.

compute.description: Compute accessibility for FORK (companion paper Compute Capture: C_train > κ · C_accessible breaks FORK).

community_compute_estimate_usd.description: C_accessible: estimated compute budget of the community (companion paper).

kappa.description: Policy constant for Compute Capture (companion paper). Capture iff training_cost > κ × community_compute.

swap_time_minutes.description: Time to swap to an alternative compatible model with equivalent task performance.

data.description: Data accessibility for FORK (companion paper Data Capture, Definition 5.2: D_required > κ_D · D_accessible breaks FORK independently of compute). Compute Capture and Data Capture are independent failure axes; the Joint Forkability Condition requires evading both.

training_corpus_reproducible.description: The corpus required to train a functionally equivalent model can be produced without infrastructure the open community cannot reproduce.

kappa_d.description: Data-accessibility multiplier κ_D ≥ 1 (companion paper). Capture iff D_required > κ_D × D_accessible.

required_to_accessible_ratio.description: Declared D_required / D_accessible estimate, in the operator's stated corpus unit.

public_substitute_equivalence_auditable.description: Where a public corpus is claimed as an equivalent substitute, the equivalence is auditable (companion paper: a substitute closes the gap only if auditable).

upstream_dependencies.description: Taxonomy of upstream training dependencies that constitute Data Capture vectors when non-reproducible (companion paper §5.2). true = the dependency is present and not publicly reproducible.

revalidation.description: Variety Drift monitoring (companion paper): Δ(t) = V_world(t) − V_model(θ); revalidation triggered when Δ > τ.

exit.description: EXIT for EPI: workflow filtering at retrieval/inference layers (companion paper). For essential systems, augment with FEE per paper §6.7.2.

rag_opt_out.description: Subjects can remove their data from the retrieval layer.

inference_blocking.description: Subjects can block inference on their data.

discharge_path.description: Claimed EXIT discharge path (paper EXIT definition: bounded-penalty exit, or verified FEE, or failure).

regeneration_resistant.description: Memory/Workflow EXIT (companion paper): purge alone is not the test. Termination counts only if resumption requires a fresh grant and nothing about the ended authority, including regeneration from retained derivatives, is inferable from what persists.

governance.description: GOVERN test under EPI. Same Rule A.9 conditions as DPI.

citizen_constraint_registry.description: Citizen-constraint registry (companion paper, required for high_stakes tiers): recognized subject-class representatives lodge protective constraints the validator must evaluate before executing determinations in that class: structural standing at the boundary, not only recourse after the fact.

evaluated_pre_execution.description: Lodged constraints are evaluated by the validator before execution, not reviewed after.

injunction_hooks.description: Injunction Hooks (companion paper, juridical mechanism family): APIs in the action boundary accepting rapid, cryptographically signed halt or rollback flags from recognized courts, executed without waiting for operator compliance.

accepted_issuers.description: Recognized courts and statutory tribunals whose flags execute.

fork.description: FORK for EPI distinguishes inference forkability (run an existing model) from training forkability (reproduce the model). Only training forkability satisfies FORK in the paper sense (companion paper).

compute_capture_status.description: Derived from compute.* fields and κ.

data_capture_status.description: Derived from data.* fields and κ_D. Joint Forkability (companion paper): FORK_training holds only if compute and data capture are both evaded.

governance_artifacts.description: Governance-reproducible FORK (companion paper, Resource Barriers to Forkability): artifacts sufficient for an independent team to operate and assess the system, beyond retraining it. Declared here; depth established by the audit's fork_viability.

then.description: Companion paper: non-trivial EPI tiers MUST enforce an Action Boundary.
